facts.statement: Bravasaurus is a genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur found in the Late Cretaceous Ciénaga del Río Huaco Formation in La Rioja, Argentina.
facts.quote: Bravasaurus (meaning Laguna Brava lizard) is a genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous Ciénaga del Río Huaco Formation of La Rioja, Argentina.

facts.statement: The genus name Bravasaurus comes from Laguna Brava National Park in Argentina.
facts.quote: The generic name Bravasaurus is derived from the Laguna Brava National Park in Argentina.

facts.statement: The species name arreirosorum honors the arrieros, 19th-century cattle drivers who crossed the Andes.
facts.quote: The specific name refers to the people, the arriero or drivers in Spanish, who carried cattle through the Andes in the 19th century.

facts.statement: Bravasaurus measured roughly 7 meters in length and weighed nearly 2.9 metric tons.
facts.quote: Bravasaurus was roughly 7 m long and weighed nearly 2.9 MT.

facts.statement: The holotype CRILAR-Pv 612 includes vertebrae, ribs, limb bones, and pelvic fragments, while the paratype CRILAR-Pv 613 contains an isolated tooth and additional limb and pelvic bones.
facts.quote: It is known from the holotype CRILAR-Pv 612, which consists of the right quadrate and quadratojugal, four cervical, five dorsal, and three caudal vertebrae, few dorsal ribs, three haemal arches, the left humerus, a fragmentary ulna, the metacarpal IV, a partial left ilium with sacral ribs, the right pubis, a partial ischium, the left femur, and both fibulae, and the paratype CRILAR-Pv 613, which consists of an isolated tooth, the right ilium, the right femur, and dorsal ribs.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis places Bravasaurus as a derived Lithostrotian within the clade Aeolosaurini, a subclade of Rinconsauria.
facts.quote: The describers' phylogenetic analysis places Bravasaurus as a derived member of the Lithostrotia, in the clade Aeolosaurini, which they recover as a subclade of Rinconsauria, different from other cladograms.

facts.statement: Bravasaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous, from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian, approximately 74 to 70 million years ago in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, desde el Campaniense al Maastrichtiense, hace aproximadamente 74 a 70 millones de años, en lo que hoy es Sudamérica.

facts.statement: Fossils were found in sandstone layers 34 meters above the base of the Ciénaga del Río Huaco Formation at the Quebrada de Santo Domingo site in La Rioja, Argentina.
facts.quote: Sus restos fueron encontrados en los niveles de arenisca 34 metros arriba de la base de la Formación Ciénaga del Río Huaco en la Quebrada de Santo Domingo, La Rioja, al noroeste de Argentina.

facts.statement: Bravasaurus was a small-sized titanosaur, significantly smaller than Punatitan and other medium-sized sauropods like Trigonosaurus, Overosaurus, and Bonitasaura.
facts.quote: Bravasaurus fue un titanosauriano de tamaño pequeño, mucho más pequeño que Punatitan y otros saurópodos de tamaño medio, tales como Trigonosaurus, Overosaurus, y Bonitasaura.

facts.statement: If the two specimens were adults, Bravasaurus would have been around 7 meters long, similar in size to Neuquensaurus or Magyarosaurus.
facts.quote: Teniendo en cuenta que ambos especímenes podrían ser adultos su tamaño podría ser similar a Neuquensaurus o Magyarosaurus, alrededor de 7 metros de largo.

facts.statement: The time range for Bravasaurus is estimated from 83.6 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Maastrichtian (83.6 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Researchers suggest a connection between Bravasaurus and the contemporary Punatitan regarding the egg concentration found at the site.
facts.quote: The describing authors suggest some connection with either Bravasaurus or its contemporary Punatitan, which was described in the same paper.

rejected.statement: The Quebrada de Santo Domingo site preserves one of the largest concentrations of titanosaur eggs in the world.
rejected.quote: The holotype locality, the Quebrada de Santo Domingo site, preserves one of the largest concentrations of titanosaur eggs in the world.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'Santo Domingo site preserves one of the largest'
